sense: put in a machine or fitting

terms.gloss: place, set up, put in its place
evidence: Cic. Sest. 83: in rōstrīs collocātī (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The general verb for putting a thing where it is to stay: in eō locō collocāre. Also of people: to station troops, or to give a daughter in marriage (fīliam collocāre).
The plainest word, enough when the place is clear.

terms.gloss: fit out, equip (a room, a house)
terms.comment: Of fitting out a place with what it needs rather than putting one thing in: domum īnstruere (Cic. Verr. 2.4.9). For software, see install.

phrases.latin: Crās plumbārius veniet ut māchinam lavātōriam collocet.
phrases.english: The plumber is coming tomorrow to install the washing machine.

sources: Lewis & Short: colloco · Lewis & Short: pono · Lewis & Short: instruo
